positioning_note: Hot-pluggable: the Humanize brief is plain markdown+JSON, consumable by HTML PPT skills or a native PPTX workflow. This table only marks routes that really ran end-to-end with stable output; support_level moves only on real-artifact verification.

support_levels.full: Brief exit + post-render presentation checkup (--qa-from) + renderer-specific failure modes all verified on real HTML/PPTX artifacts
support_levels.brief+qa-verified: Brief exit works, and the presentation checkup (--qa-from) has run end-to-end (scan -> finding -> fix -> re-check) on this renderer's real rendered artifact; renderer-specific failure-mode rules not yet distilled
support_levels.brief-only: Brief exit works; the presentation checkup (--qa-from) leg is not yet verified on this renderer's real artifacts — no promises
